test_type: real PVE API-process crash recovery; non-vulnerable synthetic scenario
crash_point: after the real clone task completed and its UPID was committed, before clone_complete state or successful lifecycle record
limitations: Does not test a crash after PVE accepts clone but before the clone UPID is saved; that window intentionally requires manual reconciliation.
Does not simulate a lost DELETE response against live PVE; unit regressions verify that no-UPID delete intent remains manual and is not retried.
